data.name: Bar Fight Mastery
data.description: In addition to the benefits of close weapon mastery, when a bouncer confirms a critical hit against a major participant in a bar fight, she also reduces the tenacity of the crowd by her normal brawling damage amount (this amount isn't doubled). This alters close weapon mastery.
